init.title: Updates, energy and availability
init.description: Choose which sign of Total active power means grid import. This affects the two grid power sensors only; meter energy counters keep their original direction. Optionally create six standard Utility Meter helpers from Import energy and Export energy. Existing matching helpers are kept. The first calendar period starts when a helper is created. Publish the latest sensor readings at the update interval (default 30 seconds). This also controls dashboard, automation, and history updates; availability changes are immediate. Optionally enter the IP address or hostname of the Solis S2-WL-ST logger to add local inverter readings. The logger is only read (Modbus function 04); nothing is written to the inverter or logger, and SolisCloud reporting is not changed. Leave it empty to disable. When creating utility meters, select the cycles and sources; Estimated solar/household energy sources need a configured logger.
